split_policy.rare_label_handling: speaker_emotion labels with fewer than 20 total examples are grouped into 'other' for stratified splitting. Raw emotion labels are still reported individually.

proportionality.summary: The split is proportional by speaker_gender plus bucketed speaker_emotion, within integer rounding. Raw rare emotion labels were grouped into the 'other' bucket for splitting, so those individual rare labels are reported but were not independently balanced.

speaker_gender.note: Deltas are expected because split counts are integers.

speaker_emotion_bucket.note: Deltas are expected because split counts are integers.

speaker_gender_x_emotion_bucket.note: This is the actual split stratification unit: speaker_gender plus bucketed speaker_emotion.

speaker_emotion_raw.note: Deltas are expected because split counts are integers.
